mechanism: Both drugs increase photosensitivity risk and can cause phototoxic reactions when combined with UV exposure; moxifloxacin is a fluoroquinolone known for phototoxicity and adapalene is a retinoid that increases skin photosensitivity.
action: Advise patients to use strict photoprotection (SPF ≥30 sunscreen, protective clothing) and avoid excessive sun exposure during concurrent use; monitor for phototoxic reactions.
